ACEMessage field contains the success or failure messages of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitFailure)
On unhandled errors in these events, System automatically populates this field with the resolved error message.

ACEStatus field indicates the success or failure of the after commit events (AfterCommit and AfterCommitEventFailure)
Enumeration for the after commit event status codes.

Value	Name	                Meaning
1	ACESuccess	after commit event completed successfully
2	ACEFSuccess	an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and after commit event failure event completed successfully
3	ACEFFail	                an unhandled error in the after commit event was caught and another unhandled error was raised in the after commit event failure event
> 99	<custom status>	User specific status codes (Designer based)

The Data Collection Definition used to define the parametric data fields to collect and place in ParametricData.  If there is only one reference to this specific service in the Spec TransactionMap, InSite will fill in this field automatically.  If a service exists multiple times in the TransactionMap, the user will need to input which data collection definition they are using.  For instance, the CollectData service might be entered twice on the TransactionMap, once with parameters recorded every hour, and once with parameters recorded every ten minutes.  When the user is performing the ColllectData, the user would then need to specify which kind of data collection they are performing in this field.

DisplayName is the field generally used to represent an object in a user interface, especially when the user interface needs to represent an object with just one data element.  For example, to represent a revisioned object one would ordinarily need to show both the name and the revision of the object.   The display name will include enough necessary elements to represent the object--in the example of a revisioned object it will include both the name and the revision, with a separator character.   This is especially useful when viewing objects in combo boxes and other one-column lists, the display name should be used.  DisplayName is usually a non-persistent field.

HistoryMainline is the history information about a Service that is common to shopfloor transaction services. The HistoryMainline will be automatically created and filled in by the InSite application server, and will be written to the database when the transaction is successfully completed.  This field should not be updated by the client.

HistorySummary is the summary of the changes caused by a Service CDO that are not covered by the fields in the HistoryMainline object  The HistorySummary will be automatically created and filled in by the InSite application server, and will be written to the database when the transaction is successfully completed. This field should not be updated by the client.
Unique ID for an instance of this object, generated by the system.
The IntegrationTxn that is used to link historical records.
Used to set the Integration Txn value.

The flag indicates whether a transaction was initiated by an external application, such as through a REST API call. This field is crucial for managing data broadcasts, like controlling a SignalR broadcast. By default, the flag is set to false, allowing normal broadcasting of data. However, when the flag is set to true, it serves as a control mechanism to prevent broadcasting the transaction data. This indicates that the transaction was executed externally, and therefore, should not be broadcast back.
Allows to alter standard processing of a Service in case it's executed as a Remote Service.

LiveConnectInfo is primarily used for communication between InSite and non-InSite sites: e.g. ERP systems.
LiveRelayInfo. Contains all of the information to perform the Remote Service and Response. It is primarily used for communication between InSite sites: for instance when containers are shipped.

A Manufacturing Order is a request to manufacture a product. Manufacturing orders are typically originated to fulfill a sales order or inventory requirements and are often a link between MES and an ERP system. 

A Manufacturing Order can contain a list of product containers. The relationship of a container to a manufacturing order is established and maintained in the containers data record. This information is used to provide WIP status by manufacturing order and WIP updates to the ERP system.
Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.
Each instance of this object maintains a set of quantity ranges and their associated Lot Size Code to be assigned to a Sample Plan.

This object holds the parametric data fields (measurements, etc.) that need to be collected for this service.  The service determines what parametric data are needed by looking in the Transaction Map of the Spec.
FileName - used for fields that specify files.

This field is a flag to enable the processing of active mfg orders, which will validate the resources' active mfg orders with the process container mfg orders.

An XML transaction document can include a GUID as a means of identifying the transaction to ensure it gets processed only once.  If an XML transaction document includes a GUID, a row is added to this table, and is used to ensure that a transaction is only processed once in case a client such as an EAI system resends a document that has already been successfully processed.
This field provides a way to turn off all the Electronic Procedures processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

Identifies whether the Electronic Signatures should be validated and executed for the service.  This is used to turn off the processing in the subservices when they are called from a compound (the Electronic Signature processing should take place in the compound).
This field provides a way to turn off all the Maintenance Management processing (validations and executions) in a single place.

This field provides a way to turn off all the Training Requirements processing (validations and executions) in a single place.
Note that this is addition to the CheckTrainingReqs flag. The ProcessTrainingReqs will be used to turn off the feature globally, while the CheckTrainingReqs is used to control it at the individual service level.

Most Modeling entities include a reference to a document. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document.

Documents are also used to define recipe files for downloading to machines. In this case, presenting the Document means presenting it (downloading it) to a machine.
